instruction: A candid street photograph with a full-body shot of two women interacting on a city sidewalk next to a green subway railing. On the left, the woman in the beige coat and white pants (R1) stands with her back partially to the camera, gesturing with her arms slightly extended. On the right, the woman with curly hair and a brown coat (R2) stands facing her, smiling warmly with a black handbag in her hand. The scene is captured in natural daylight with soft shadows and a muted urban color palette.
